description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app demonstrating drag-and-drop functionality, including setting up draggable images, handling drag events, and managing image URIs with file provider integration.

classes.name: DragSourceFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating drag-and-drop of images, including setting up draggable images, handling drag events, and managing image URIs with file provider.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up draggable images, and initializes the local image drop target.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current local image URI state.

methods.name: setUpDraggableImage
methods.description: Configures an ImageView to start a drag-and-drop operation with specific flags and clip data.

methods.name: getFileUri
methods.description: Copies a drawable resource to internal storage and returns its URI via FileProvider.

methods.name: copyImageResourceToFile
methods.description: Copies a drawable resource into a specified file.
